verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only payment primitives: saving a card and charging its card_id, and wallet enrollments for later direct charges. The merchant would have to build the subscription logic themselves, so these count as developer building blocks rather than a subscription billing product. No evidence shows plans, trials, upgrades, proration, or dLocal-managed recurring schedules.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration
